title: Fynkel volume profile
description: `<name>.volume.json` (R3a, `docs/renderer.md` § Volumes): a post-processing profile — the look overrides a `fynkel.Volume` component applies to the frame. Every block and every field is optional: a field that is present overrides what is below it (the engine default, or a lower-priority volume), a field that is absent is inherited. The renderer blends the volumes that reach the camera once per frame, each by its weight × how far inside its shape the camera is. The project's quality profile is the ceiling: a profile can shape an effect the quality profile has on, never turn on one it has off.

ambientOcclusion.description: Screen-space ambient occlusion (R2): how much of the sky each pixel can see, applied to ambient and image-based light only.

radius.description: How far the occlusion reaches, in metres (engine default 0.6).

intensity.description: The exponent the visible fraction is raised to: 0 turns the occlusion off, 1 is linear, larger is darker (engine default 1.35).
